errata.was: 'Papyrus is a riparian sedge that ancient observers classed with grassy plants (Theophrastus, HP 4.8.3)'; 'This identification is the one point of the reading that needs the material facts of IV.2'; the seat 'filled as fully by a future singer as by a future reader'
errata.now: Version 2.4 (#1775): Theophrastus treats papyrus with the marsh plants, beside reed and κύπειρος (the λοχμώδη), not with the ποιώδη; the identification is argued from the word, the translators' record and the making of the sheet; the seat faces a text.
